parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, filter compound_records by doc_id matching the ChEMBL document ID, and join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return the results ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
